description: Check whether an address will become a validator when this epoch ends: its registered consensus key, work this epoch, rank among eligible miners, blocks (and estimated seconds) until the validator set is picked, whether it's a validator now and with what voting power, and its escrowed mining rewards. From block 396,000 seats follow seat work (selectionRule seat_work_power): the difficulty met over the last 3 epochs, native and merged-mined. The address is required. Read-only; every field is as of one block height.

address.description: Aether account address (aether1...); required, this server holds no key

name: get_miner_status

activeValidator.description: in the validator set right now

eligible.description: can be picked when this epoch ends: has work this epoch, a registered consensus key, and no ban

avgBlockSeconds.description: measured over the last 1,000 blocks; 0 if it couldn't be measured

blocksUntilSelection.description: 0 means the selection block is the latest block, already applied; the next epoch starts at the next block

estSecondsUntilSelection.description: an estimate from avgBlockSeconds, not a guarantee

selectionHeight.description: the epoch's last block: work submitted up to and including it counts, and it picks the next validator set, which takes effect two blocks later

balance.description: mining rewards held back until unlockHeight

aeth.description: AETH amounts only: the amount in AETH

amount.description: the amount in the asset's own unit, e.g. 1.5

asset.description: AETH, or USDC (the one its owner configured: issuer and route are in origin)

base.description: the same amount in the asset's smallest unit (uaeth or uusdc; 1 = 1,000,000 of them)

denom.description: the chain's name for the asset: uaeth, or ibc/... for USDC

uaeth.description: AETH amounts only: the amount in uaeth

height.description: every field is as of this block

nextSelectionRule.description: a different rule that applies from nextRuleFromHeight

notEligibleBecause.description: any of no_work_this_epoch, no_consensus_key, banned; under seat_work_power no_seat_work_in_window or below_minimum_share in place of no_work_this_epoch

onTrack.description: would be picked if the epoch ended now; never true under beacon_weighted_sample, since a random draw isn't known in advance

rank.description: 1-based position among eligible miners by work (by seat work under seat_work_power); absent if not eligible

registeredConsensusKey.description: a consensus public key is registered for this address; without one, mining never makes it a validator

seatWork.description: under seat_work_power: the difficulty this address's accepted submissions met over the last 3 epochs, native and merged-mined; it decides seats and power

seatWorkThisEpoch.description: under seat_work_power: the part of seatWork earned in this epoch

seatWorkTotal.description: under seat_work_power: the total the 1% bar is measured against: every address's seat work over the window (from the seat hardening height, registered addresses' only)

selectionRule.description: top_k_by_work: the topKSize eligible miners with the most work are picked; beacon_weighted_sample: topKSize are drawn at random, weighted by work; seat_work_power: the topKSize miners with the most seat work over the window are seated, each with power in proportion to it (power moves at most 10% of the total an epoch)

votingPower.description: this address's voting power in the validator set at height; 0 outside it

workShare.description: 0 to 1: this address's share of all eligible work this epoch; under seat_work_power, its share of all the window's seat work, which must be at least 0.01 to qualify

title: Get miner status
